title: MAI/ISE Asset Mapping, Snapping & Semantic Construction Roles
objective: Map permitted tilesets, images, structured map imports and placeables into semantic construction roles; support attachment/snapping suggestions, replacement assets and imported wall/door/room metadata without turning pixels into game truth, while preserving canonical MAI, ISE, Asset, Permission and completed SSA ownership.

persistence.reason: SSA-06 adds projection and proposal semantics over existing asset, Scene and SSA identities; it does not establish a new canonical asset, entitlement, construction or provider ledger.

preserved_boundaries: SSA-01 through SSA-05 remain completed_verified with retired implementation authority.
MAI remains canonical for map/visual asset interoperability and completed ISE remains canonical for the native playable Scene surface.
Asset, Permission/entitlement, Scene, provider/media-rights and other owner domains remain canonical.
Pixels, visual proximity, image adjacency and recognition output never become structural or semantic truth without governed metadata or confirmation.
Generated snapping, attachment, replacement and construction-role suggestions remain assistance until confirmed where certainty is insufficient.
Provider credentials/secrets, commercial media bytes, entitlement inference and redistribution remain outside SSA-06 authority.
Hidden/GM-only construction semantics and protected cardinality remain filtered before player/accessibility/diagnostic/export/AI projection.
Consequential construction-role information/actions require accessible nonvisual representation.
No durable SSA-06 persistence change is required and migration 0022 remains unreserved.
SSA-07+, paid provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
